production: Keep qwen38-27b running, unchanged. Idle checks, no stop/restart. Initial free >2 GiB, process Torch reserve <1 GiB.
arithmetic: Stable SwiGLU exactly as blocks.cu; explicitly round intermediate to F16 before group32 two-pass residual A8/F32 scales. Q8 weights unchanged. No single-pass arithmetic.
correctness: Full workspace bytes and all Down F32 outputs must match pinned separate path. Finite F16 intermediate bits, subnormal/zero/nonfinite/overflow/group tails, guards, exact input alias and forbidden overlaps; dynamic graph replay. Exhaustive F16 gate bit patterns with several up values.
scopes: MLP TP projection shard: input quantization + gate/up + producer + Down. Excludes norms, residuals, TP transport/sum, recurrence, attention and serving.
input_source: Production Qwen3.8 GGUF Q8_0 gate/up/down TP-half weight bytes; gate/up outputs from synthetic F16 hidden inputs. Not actual full-model activations.
timing: 20-node micrographs, 5 replays/100 logical calls per wave, 7 alternating repeats. Independent confirm layer0 T1/T8, same four arms and scopes. CPU/wall and GPU events separate.
promotion: Research only, no default integration/production deployment. Retain a variant only with byte correctness, >=5% producer latency reduction and >=1% median producer+Down latency reduction in screen and confirmation, with no >2% confirmed regression at tested T1/T8.
diagnostics: Separate NCU producer-only counters, two separate kernels versus one fused kernel. Keep normal timing separate. No profiling policy or clock changes.
